[Variation of the Levi-Civita connection] 1. ch2:3.1 Source: topping:page-0029 \group topping-background

For \[ \Pi (X,Y):= rac{\partial }{\partial t}( abla _XY), \] one has \[ \langle \Pi (X,Y),Z angle = rac12 igl[( abla _Yh)(X,Z)+( abla _Xh)(Y,Z)-( abla _Zh)(X,Y) igr]. \]
